entity.description: An agent: its instructions (Markdown, inline or at instructionsLocation), the model it uses (a feature binding, else a tier), its default reasoning level, the role group that bounds what it may do (its authority is the user's, intersected with the group's and the tool policy), the surfaces it serves (a comma list of drawer, chat, a2a, mcp, job, tui; empty is drawer and tui only), the screen a headless session starts on, and its budgets. runAsUserId is for jobs and triggers, which have no user of their own. requireSkill names skills the agent always loads. a2aSkillsJson describes its skills on the A2A agent card. canvasDialects is a comma list of the canvas dialects it may write (openui, vue-sfc); empty is openui only, so Vue SFC canvases are off unless an agent names them. chatUserId is the service user that is the agent's member in chat rooms (a ChatRoomMember with role CmrAgent and the agentRef handle#ChatMessage). A system agent (isSystem) ships in seed data.

Which tools an agent may call, in sequence order, the first matching pattern deciding: toolPattern is a tool name or a pattern with *, the classification ceiling is the highest it may run (read, write, destructive, external), the approval mode is ask (the user decides each), policy (runs without asking, background agents only) or never (the tool is not offered), and callsPerRun limits the calls of one run.

A service offered as a tool: its tool name, the service, the title and description the model reads, an input schema that replaces the one made from the service's parameters, its classification (else the service's own), whether the assistant and the MCP server offer it, and whether its writes get a sim preview (none, on-demand, always). lockVersion changes with each edit, so a run that started with another version notices.

A conversation of a user with an agent on one surface; it is an A2A context (conversationId is the contextId). A chat-room conversation names its room and thread root. One run at a time is active (activeRunId, set with a conditional update). The frozen prefix of the prompt (systemText, toolsHash, promptVariant, standard or small with +json for JSON tool mode, and skillCatalog, the names its skill catalog lists) is fixed when the conversation starts, so every call shares the provider's prefix cache; compaction keeps a summary of the messages through compactedThroughSeq. screenStateJson is the state of its screen session, recordEntityName and recordId the record it is attached to. clientId is the follow owner (the drawer tab whose page follows the agent: the one that sent the last turn or claimed follow), and contextVersion the newest page version its tab reported (raised when the user navigates); the agent's ui.* events carry both, so a tab applies only its own and only for the page they were made for.

field.name: memoryCreate
field.description: The temporary memory gate of this conversation: Y or N lets or stops the agent making memories here whatever the user's ASSIST_MEMORY preference (the permanent gate) says; empty follows the preference. Existing memories are used either way.

entity.description: One user request carried to an end, across pauses; it is an A2A task (runId is the task id). Its status is an A2A task state (AgentRun status type; llm/run/state.rs). A paused run (input or auth required) names what it waits for: pauseKindEnumId, pauseRef and pauseExpireDate. The node running it holds a lease (leaseOwner, leaseExpireDate, renewed every 15 seconds); a recovery sweep takes over a Working run whose lease expired, at most maxAttempts times. cancelRequested is read at each renewal, so a cancel reaches the node running the run. parentRunId is the run that delegated this one. The counts and totals are kept as the steps end; resultJson is the final answer, so a repeated request is answered the same.

field.name: clientRequestId
field.description: The caller's own id of the request (an A2A messageId), so a request sent again gets this run

field.name: maxRunSeconds
field.description: The cap on activeSeconds; a continue at the budget raises it

field.name: capsText
field.description: The surface capabilities in effect for the run (a comma list), which decide the tools offered

field.name: tier
field.description: The tier the client chose for this run (fast, balanced, thorough); an agent that names its own tier keeps it

field.name: activeSeconds
field.description: Wall time spent working, without pauses

entity.description: One step of a run: one model call (callId, the last attempt) and the tool calls it asked for.

The stored events of a run, numbered per run (eventSeq), which a client that re-attaches reads from the last one it has: run.state, message.start, text.chunk, tool.call, approval.requested and the others of the plan's 4.5. The deltas are live only.

Input for a run that arrived while it worked or paused: a message folded in at the next step (steering), an answer to its question, a decision, or a remote agent's reply. consumedDate is set when the run takes it.

field.name: clientMessageId
field.description: The client's own id of a message (a drawer turn sent while a run was active), unique with the user as on AgentMessage, so a send tried again finds it

entity.description: A message of a conversation, numbered in it (messageSeq): role user, assistant, tool or system. A client's own id of a message it sends (clientMessageId) is unique for the user, so a send that is tried again finds the message it made. replayJson is what the provider needs back with the next request (reasoning signatures, encrypted reasoning items), sent only to the same endpoint and model (replayEndpointId, replayModelId). A compacted message is summarized and no longer sent. An assistant message's tokenCount is the prompt tokens the provider reported for the request that made it (promptChars in its metadata is that request's characters), the anchor of the window's estimate; its metadata raw is the text a model wrote in JSON tool mode.

A part of a message, A2A-shaped, one of: text (textValue), data (dataJson, with mediaType), file (fileName, mediaType, fileLocation or fileUrl), tool call (toolCallId, the tool and its arguments in dataJson), tool result (toolCallId, the result in textValue) or reasoning (textValue, a summary).

A tool call of a run: the provider's id of it, the tool, its classification, its arguments and their canonical hash. A call left running when its node stopped is UnknownOutcome: a read may run again, a write never does. The result goes to the model as resultSummary; a large one is spilled to spillLocation for a later read. approvalId is the approval a write waited for. surfaceEnumId and clientId say where the call came from (a direct MCP tools/call has no run). catalogToolName is the lazy catalog entry a run_tool call ran, which its calls-per-run limit counts.

A write the agent asked to make, decided only by its user (userId) in an interactive session: bound to the tool and the canonical hash of its arguments, single use and expiring (expireDate). targetKind and targetName are what it calls (a service, a screen transition); snapshotJson is the current values of the records it changes (recordRefsJson), shown against the proposed ones, and checked again before it runs (a change meanwhile is Conflict). previewJson is the result of the optional sim preview. An edited approval keeps the edited arguments; HandedOff passes it to the user's own Save in the screen. policy names the policy rule that let a background run decide it without asking.
A question the agent asked (the ask tool): its text, a form schema when it asks for fields, the choices, and the answer.

A hand-off watch: the agent filled a screen and the user saves it themselves; the watch waits for the transition (screenPath, transitionName) and records what came of it (outcomeJson: saved with its messages, a validation error, or abandoned).
Something a run made (an A2A artifact): a response, a canvas (dialect, source and version in its parts), a file or a report. Updated in place, with its version counting the changes.
A part of an artifact, shaped as AgentMessagePart.

A skill in the index: instructions an agent loads on demand by name. Its body is from a file (sourceLocation, component://name/skill/..., with a contentHash to notice changes; synced at startup, its text never edited here) or written here; frontMatterJson keeps the front matter that has no column (unlocks, requires, screens, services, risk, agents, surfaces, version, overrides, section purposes); skillKind is procedure, reference or guide. A personal skill has an owner and shadows a site skill of the same name unless that one is locked. Only published rows are in the index (versionNum counts changes); provenance says where it came from (framework, component, admin, user, learned), and only a skill a person wrote may lower a risk.
A skill an admin pins to an agent: always in its catalog, or always loaded (alwaysLoad).

A skill loaded in a run: sectionName is empty for its head (the text before the first section and the contents), * for the whole body, else the section's slug; a gated tool reads these by conversation. How it went (outcome: helped, unused, failed) comes with the lessons.

A lesson learned in use, anchored to a skill, a screen path or a service: visible to its author at once, to others once a reviewer approves it (AglApproved). Proposed by the agent's remember with about, by a rejection with feedback, or by the user; shown only with a skill load or a screen answer on its anchor, as untrusted text, never in the frozen prefix.
A fact the agent keeps about its user (for one agent when agentId is set), from the conversation that made it. Used while active; a temporary memory ends at thruDate.
A prompt the drawer suggests: on screens whose path matches screenPathPattern, or for records of entityName; sent at once (sendMode send) or put in the composer (prefill).

An agent run started on a schedule (cronExpression, through the ServiceJob agent_trigger_[triggerId] that store#AgentTrigger keeps) or by a record change (a DataDocument the AgentTriggers DataFeed delivers): its instructions, the user it runs as (runAsUserId, else the agent's), a batch window that gathers events into one run (batchSeconds), run limits (maxRunsPerHour, 60 when empty; maxRunsPerDay; maxConcurrent, 2 when empty), and a breaker that opens after failureLimit failures in a row (breakerState closed or open; an admin resets it). approvalHold Y puts a write its policy does not approve in the run-as user's inbox as an approval to decide; N (the default) makes it an error the model reads. A record change the trigger's own agent made does not fire it (the loop guard). conditionExpression is not evaluated: the DataDocument's own conditions choose the records.

field.name: maxBatchEvents
field.description: Events one run takes at most (default 50); the rest wait for the next run

entity.description: The outbox of a document trigger: each event (the delivered document, or a deleted one's ids) waits until the batch window closes, then one run takes the batch (runId, set with a conditional update so one node takes it). A cron firing has no events.
An A2A push notification config of a task: where to post its updates, with a token and credentials that are stored encrypted and never returned.
The push outbox: an update to deliver, its attempts and the next try.

A remote A2A agent an agent may delegate to (the tool a2a__remoteId, docs/A2A.md): its card URL (admin configuration only), its authentication (encrypted, never shown: {"bearer": key}, {"basic": {username, password}} or {"header": {name, value}}), the card as last read, the local agents that may delegate to it (allowedAgents, comma separated, * for all; empty for none), whether its address may be a private one (allowPrivateNetwork: loopback, LAN), and the seconds a delegation may wait (timeoutSeconds, else the conf's a2a client-timeout).

A task of a remote A2A agent that a run of ours started, or a call of a remote MCP server's tool that waits for input (mcpServerId, its requestState), and its last known state: the tool call resumes from it when the user answers the remote's question or comes back from its link.

A remote MCP server whose tools agents may call (the tools mcp__server__tool, docs/MCP.md): its URL (admin configuration only), its authentication (encrypted, never shown, as AgentRemoteA2a's), whether each user calls with a token of their own (AgentMcpUserToken), the local agents that may call it (allowedAgents, comma separated, * for all; empty for none), whether its address may be a private one (allowPrivateNetwork), and the seconds a call may take (timeoutSeconds, else the conf's mcp call-timeout).

A tool of a remote MCP server that agents may call (only the tools these rows allow are offered), with its classification: none is EXTERNAL, which asks for the user's approval as a write does; an admin may mark a tool READ (it then runs at once, under the read fence with only its server let through). The description, when set, replaces the server's own.
A user's own token for a remote MCP server (encrypted).
Each read of another user's conversation, run or LLM call content by a user with AgentAudit: who, what, when and why.

field.name: callId
field.description: An LlmCall whose request and response were read
